LightningComponentBundle.description: Ranked worklist (who / why / score) from any semantic model. Selecting a row filters the dashboard to that entity. Re-bind to households, clients or policies without redeploying.

property.name: entityField
property.label: Entity Dimension
property.description: Who the action is for (e.g. Household Name).

property.name: contextField
property.label: Context Dimension
property.description: Optional 'why' shown under the entity (e.g. Segment, Event Type).

property.name: scoreField
property.label: Score Measure
property.description: Measure used to rank (e.g. Product Count with Avg, Opportunity Value with Sum).

property.name: lowestFirst
property.label: Lowest score first
property.description: Rank ascending (e.g. fewest products = most urgent).
